articles.title: US Senate to vote on advancing CLARITY Act in September after Thune files cloture
articles.snippet: The procedural move puts crypto market structure legislation back on track as lawmakers continue negotiations over ethics and stablecoin provisions.

articles.title: Domestic stablecoins could boost demand for dollar-backed tokens: IMF
articles.snippet: IMF first deputy managing director Dan Katz says users may favor digital dollars for their liquidity, network effects and cross-border acceptance.

articles.title: Circle expands USDC to OKX ecosystem with X Layer launch
articles.snippet: The rollout gives X Layer users access to Circle-issued USDC and crosschain transfers as the stablecoin expands across major blockchain ecosystems.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Crypto’s biggest business is starting to look a lot like banking
articles.snippet: Crypto business is converging with banking as stablecoin reserves, tokenized funds, Treasury income and balance sheet management become key profit drivers.

articles.title: What Is Arc? The Stablecoin Blockchain From USDC Issuer Circle
articles.snippet: Arc is a new layer-1 blockchain developed by USDC issuer Circle, designed specifically for stablecoin-native finance.
